formula.factor: factor *= (1 + common_stock_dividend_ratio)/(1 - registered_cash / previous_raw_krx_close); cash once only; same frozen partial-distribution index convention, not complete shareholder wealth
formula.ohlc: raw_krx_ohlc[t] * cumulative_known_partial_distribution_factor[t] within each connected source segment
formula.unvaluedRights: NaN OHLC on official ex-right session; reset segment normalization to 1.0. Every backward window crossing boundary is invalid, including endpoint-only functions; formal labels already inspect every holding-window price. Never bridge or assign a payoff to the right.
formula.volume: raw_krx_volume / cumulative_same_common_stock_entitlement_ratio; cash and cross-class subscription rights never alter common volume units

limits: Original partial-distribution and historical-vendor-vintage limitations remain; not certification of all stock shareholder economics.
No independent 2018 unlisted right valuation: windows spanning the official ex-right boundary remain invalid permanently.
KRX authentication is unavailable in this environment; exact preserved official KRX objects are used, not discarded or relabelled.

rightsEvent.reason: Subscription right was not exchange-listed; do not substitute issue price or observed common-price change for right value.

sourceValidityGuards.allAdjustedPriceFeatures: Original basis_cause windows plus all intermediate quote validity for endpoint-only industry and relative/momentum readers
sourceValidityGuards.unknownRightsCrossingLabels: Frozen label engine already requires every holding-window close finite. No real label is constructed during authoring.
sourceValidityGuards.verifiedRawNonPriceInformation: Unchanged KRX volume, proxy traded value, capacity, accounting, membership and industry classification; no blanket non-price mask

stockDividendEvent.availabilityRule: New share entitlement factor is applied forward starting at ex date only; final share listing is corroboration, not information attributed to earlier signals.
